lines.say: You probably run more than one coding agent now.
Claude Code in one pane. Codex in another. A shell for your tests.

lines.head: Copy. Paste. Wait.
lines.say: And you're the one carrying everything between them. Copy. Paste. Wait. Copy it back.

lines.head: You are the message bus.
lines.say: You've become the message bus.

lines.head: Namedrop
lines.say: This is Namedrop.

lines.head: @mentions for your agents.
lines.say: At-mentions for your agents. It's a plugin for Herdr that lets every agent in your workspace reach any other, by name.
lines.spoken: At mentions for your agents. It's a plugin for Herder that lets every agent in your workspace reach any other, by name.

lines.head: Give it a name.
lines.say: It starts with a name. Tell an agent, name yourself @reviewer.
lines.spoken: It starts with a name. Tell an agent, name yourself at reviewer.

lines.head: Mention it.
lines.say: Now, from any other pane, just mention it. Ask @reviewer to check the retry logic.
lines.show: Ask @reviewer to check the retry logic. Use their feedback to fix any bugs.
lines.spoken: Now, from any other pane, just mention it. Ask at reviewer to check the retry logic.

lines.say: Your agent sends the request, and keeps working on your goal.

lines.head: The answer comes back.
lines.say: When the review is done, the answer comes back to the pane that asked.

lines.head: Claude Code. Codex. Same names.
lines.say: Claude Code or Codex. It works the same either way.
Ask two agents at once. @reviewer checks correctness. @tester looks for missing tests.
lines.show: Ask @reviewer to inspect correctness and @tester to find missing test cases. Give me one answer with the changes I should make.
lines.spoken: Ask two agents at once. at reviewer checks correctness. at tester looks for missing tests.

lines.head: Tracked.
lines.say: The lead tracks each assignment, and gets a nudge if anything stalls.

lines.head: One answer.
lines.say: Then it reviews what comes back, and hands you one answer.

lines.head: Terminals have names too.
lines.say: Even a plain shell can have a name.

lines.head: No model. No tokens.
lines.say: @build, cargo test. It runs once, in that shell. No model. No tokens.
lines.spoken: at build, cargo test. It runs once, in that shell. No model. No tokens.

lines.say: The output and the exit code go straight back to the agent that asked.

lines.head: No boss required.
lines.say: And you don't need a boss agent at the top.
Give each agent its own job, and they reach each other directly. @tester runs the suite on @build, and tells @coder what failed.
lines.spoken: Give each agent its own job, and they reach each other directly. at tester runs the suite on at build, and tells at coder what failed.

lines.head: They pick their own collaborators.
lines.say: Describe what each agent is good at, and they pick their own collaborators from the roster.
lines.show: Reviews Rust changes for correctness and risk

lines.head: @review-team
lines.say: Save a few of them as a group, and mention the group like a name.
lines.show: @review-team Review the authentication changes before I merge them.

lines.head: Pinned to the code it read.
lines.say: Every review can be pinned to the exact code it read.

lines.head: Fresh. Or stale.
lines.say: When the code moves, Namedrop tells you whether that review is still fresh, or stale.
lines.spoken: When the code moves, Name drop tells you whether that review is still fresh, or stale.

lines.head: See everything.
lines.say: Press Prefix, then Shift S, and see what every agent is doing, and what you're still waiting on.
If something's stuck, namedrop doctor tells you exactly how to fix it.
lines.spoken: If something's stuck, Name drop doctor tells you exactly how to fix it.

lines.head: Data. Never orders.
lines.say: Context you share stays with the session you sent it to. And a message from another agent is always data, never orders.
So you stop being the message bus, and get back to the decisions only you can make.

lines.head: Namedrop
lines.say: Namedrop.

lines.head: Name it. Mention it. Get the answer back.
lines.say: Give an agent a name. Mention it. Get the answer back where you asked.
Install it in Herdr today.
